verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the /stages endpoint, which returns recruitment pipeline stages defined once on the recruiting preferences page. That covers reusable stages, but only at the account level, not as a per-role interview plan. Candidate ratings exist, but nothing in the pack shows structured interview content. Missing for 10: per-role interview plans or kits, question banks, per-interviewer focus areas or assignments, reusable interview templates, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
